description: A TypeScript source file implementing a client for sending messages and fetching user data from Synology Chat via HTTP/HTTPS, including rate limiting, caching, and user ID resolution.

classes.name: ChatUser
classes.description: Represents a user in Synology Chat with user_id, username, and nickname.

classes.name: ChatUserCacheEntry
classes.description: Cache entry containing a list of ChatUser objects and a timestamp.

classes.name: ChatWebhookPayload
classes.description: Payload structure for webhook messages, including text, file URL, and user IDs.

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Sends a text message to Synology Chat via webhook, with rate limiting and retries.

methods.name: sendFileUrl
methods.description: Sends a file URL message to Synology Chat.

methods.name: fetchChatUsers
methods.description: Fetches and caches the list of Chat users visible to the bot.

methods.name: resolveLegacyWebhookNameToChatUserId
methods.description: Resolves a webhook username or nickname to the internal Chat user ID.
